terms.comment: To make peace with someone, pācem facere cum aliquō; to break the peace, pācem frangere; in peace and in war, domī mīlitiaeque (Traupman 187).

phrases.latin: melior tūtiorque est certa pāx quam spērāta victōria
phrases.english: a sure peace is better and safer than a hoped-for victory
